nodes.text: Like what?

nodes.text: Wait... Then this means I'm... I'm dreaming, right?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, you did just fall through a basketball court.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ohmygosh... There are `so` many things I want to talk to you about!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ohmygosh... There are [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] many things I want to talk to you about!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I know, and I want to talk about all of them, but that can't happen now...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Not while you're like this.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You're totally distressed, Em.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: We probably don't have much time before something crazy happens in your subconscious...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And we can't have a conversation when crazy things are happening, can we?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: But what if I promise that nothing crazy will happen?
The pool starts to rumble...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Starting now. Nothing crazy starting now.

nodes.text: You need to find peace in your subconscious, sis. Then we can talk...

nodes.text: `No!`

nodes.text: Please, please don't be mad at me...

nodes.text: Are you okay?!

nodes.text: I'm hurt real bad!

nodes.text: What's hurt?

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: I didn't mean it!

nodes.speaker: Ref
nodes.text: You're on thin ice, son!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Looks like you're back in, Kale. Sooner than I wanted. `Don't` foul out!
nodes.text_bbcode: Looks like you're back in, Kale. Sooner than I wanted. [color=#e23b3b][i]Don't[/i][/color] foul out!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What is it?
